notes.title: RetroFight public release !
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to officially announce the release of our game, "RetroFight"! After months of passionate effort, bursts of creativity, and sleepless nights, our team is excited to invite you to dive into this coop adventure.

We started this project a year ago and as our second game, we tried to make everything perfect for our players. 

Available Now!
RetroFight is now available on Steam. Dive into the adventure right away and share your games with the community. 
We want to thank every person who contributed to making this dream a reality ! 

For 1 week starting on release date (11th october 2024), get the game for -20% on Steam shop !

What are you waiting for ?
